# Atlassian

> Atlassian provides collaboration, project management, software development, service management, and knowledge-sharing tools for teams.

Atlassian’s platform spans products for software delivery, IT operations, documentation, planning, customer support, and enterprise collaboration. Its core ecosystem includes Jira, Confluence, Trello, Bitbucket, Loom, and Jira Service Management, along with platform services, developer resources, support, and product-specific documentation.

## Core Products
- [Jira](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira): Project and issue tracking software for planning, tracking, and delivering work.
- [Confluence](https://www.atlassian.com/software/confluence): Team workspace for documentation, knowledge sharing, and collaborative content creation.
- [Trello](https://www.atlassian.com/software/trello): Visual task and project management using boards, lists, and cards.
- [Jira Service Management](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/service-management): Service management platform for IT, operations, and support teams.
- [Bitbucket](https://www.atlassian.com/software/bitbucket): Git code collaboration platform with pull requests and CI/CD capabilities.
- [Loom](https://www.atlassian.com/software/loom): Video messaging and screen recording tool for async communication.
- [Atlas](https://www.atlassian.com/software/atlas): Teamwork directory and status updates for goals, projects, and teams.
- [Guard](https://www.atlassian.com/software/guard): Security and identity capabilities for protecting Atlassian cloud organizations.

## Platform and Enterprise Tools
- [Rovo](https://www.atlassian.com/software/rovo): AI-powered search, chat, and agents across Atlassian and connected tools.
- [Compass](https://www.atlassian.com/software/compass): Developer experience platform for software component catalogs and scorecards.
- [Jira Product Discovery](https://www.atlassian.com/software/jira/product-discovery): Product prioritization and roadmap tool for capturing and evaluating ideas.
- [Statuspage](https://www.atlassian.com/software/statuspage): Incident communication platform for publishing service status and updates.
- [Opsgenie](https://www.atlassian.com/software/opsgenie): Alerting and on-call management for incident response teams.
- [Atlassian Analytics](https://www.atlassian.com/software/analytics): Cross-product analytics and reporting for Atlassian cloud data.
- [Atlassian Administration](https://www.atlassian.com/software/admin): Centralized administration for users, billing, and organization settings.

## Product Documentation
- [Atlassian Documentation](https://support.atlassian.com/): Central documentation hub for Atlassian cloud and data center products.
- [Jira Documentation](https://support.atlassian.com/jira-software-cloud/): Product documentation for Jira Software Cloud features and administration.
- [Confluence Documentation](https://support.atlassian.com/confluence-cloud/): Documentation for Confluence Cloud usage, spaces, pages, and administration.
- [Jira Service Management Documentation](https://support.atlassian.com/jira-service-management-cloud/): Documentation for service projects, queues, portals, and operations.
- [Trello Help](https://support.atlassian.com/trello/): Help and documentation for Trello boards, automation, and workspace management.
- [Bitbucket Cloud Documentation](https://support.atlassian.com/bitbucket-cloud/): Documentation for repositories, pull requests, pipelines, and permissions.
- [Compass Documentation](https://support.atlassian.com/compass/): Documentation for component catalogs, scorecards, and developer experience workflows.
- [Statuspage Documentation](https://support.atlassian.com/statuspage/): Documentation for incident communication, pages, components, and subscribers.

## Developer Documentation
- [Atlassian Developer](https://developer.atlassian.com/): Developer portal for building apps, integrations, and extensions on Atlassian.
- [Forge](https://developer.atlassian.com/platform/forge/): Atlassian’s cloud app platform for building hosted apps and automations.
- [Connect](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/getting-started-with-connect/): Framework for integrating apps with Atlassian cloud products.
- [Jira Cloud Platform REST API](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/rest/v3/intro/): REST API reference for Jira Cloud platform resources and operations.
- [Confluence Cloud REST API](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/confluence/rest/v2/intro/): REST API reference for Confluence Cloud content and space operations.
- [Jira Software Cloud REST API](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/software/rest/): API reference for Jira Software agile boards, sprints, and development data.
- [Bitbucket Cloud REST API](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/bitbucket/rest/): API reference for Bitbucket repositories, workspaces, and pipelines.
- [OAuth 2.0 for Atlassian Cloud](https://developer.atlassian.com/cloud/jira/platform/oauth-2-3lo-apps/): Guide to authenticating cloud integrations with OAuth 2.0.

- [Strategy Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/strategy): Products for strategic planning, goals, and enterprise execution alignment.
- [Software Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/software): Integrated tools for software planning, development, and delivery workflows.
- [Service Collection](https://www.atlassian.com/collections/service): Products for IT, operations, and support service management.
- [Software Development](https://www.atlassian.com/solutions/software): Solution overview for planning, building, and shipping software.
- [IT Service Management](https://www.atlassian.com/solutions/it-service-management): Solution overview for IT support, operations, and service delivery.
- [Work Management](https://www.atlassian.com/solutions/work-management): Solution overview for business teams managing projects and processes.
- [Marketing](https://www.atlassian.com/solutions/marketing): Use cases and workflows for marketing planning and campaign collaboration.

## Support and Administration
- [Support Home](https://support.atlassian.com/): Entry point for product help, troubleshooting, and account support.
- [Atlassian Cloud Admin](https://support.atlassian.com/organization-administration/): Documentation for managing organizations, users, and security settings.
- [Billing and Subscription Management](https://support.atlassian.com/subscriptions-and-billing/): Help for plans, billing, renewals, and subscription administration.
- [Atlassian Access Support](https://support.atlassian.com/security-and-access-policies/): Documentation for authentication, SSO, and security policy management.
- [Migration Program](https://www.atlassian.com/migration): Resources for migrating from server or data center to cloud.
- [Trust Center](https://www.atlassian.com/trust): Security, privacy, compliance, and reliability information for Atlassian products.
- [System Status](https://status.atlassian.com/): Service availability and incident status for Atlassian cloud products.
